en: A color illustration of a quiet winter evening in the countryside. Snow covers the ground, bare trees stand to the right, and a large yellow sun or moon glows low in a greenish sky. In the middle distance is a small wooden house with lighted windows and smoke from the chimney. A person in a coat walks toward the house, while in the foreground a dog stands near a small wooden footbridge over a narrow stream. The scene has a soft, painterly, early‑20th‑century style and no visible printed text on the image side.
